reasoning: Both meetings maintain identical policy directives: the $600 billion QE2 program at ~$80 billion/month through end of Q2, the 0-0.25% fed funds rate target, and 'extended period' forward guidance. The March meeting adds language about monitoring inflation and commodity price pressures, but explicitly characterizes these effects as 'transitory' and makes no change to the program. The discussion of tapering QE2 purchases was resolved in the same direction as January — almost all participants saw no need to taper — confirming continuity rather than a pivot.
key_quote: The Committee expects these effects to be transitory, but it will pay close attention to the evolution of inflation and inflation expectations.
